q: Peraturan 9 Peraturan SHO 1997 membolehkan Ketua Pengarah:
c: Menolak pendaftaran jika pemohon tidak memenuhi keperluan yang ditetapkan
e: Refusal to register (Reg. 9): the DG may refuse to register any application if satisfied that the applicant does not meet the prescribed requirements.

q: Bahagian III Peraturan SHO 1997 berkaitan dengan:
c: Pemberitahuan tentang SHO
e: Part I Preliminary; II Registration; III Notification of a SHO; IV Duties of an Employer; V Duties of SHO; VI Miscellaneous.

q: Menurut tafsiran Peraturan 2, 'no loss-time injury' ialah kecederaan yang:
c: Tiada masa kerja hilang melebihi yang diperlukan untuk rawatan perubatan
e: No loss-time injury: an injury where no work is lost beyond that required for medical attention.

q: Menurut Peraturan 2, 'near-miss accident' ialah:
c: Kemalangan di tempat kerja yang berpotensi mencederakan orang atau merosakkan harta
e: Near-miss accident: any accident at a place of work which has the potential of causing injury to any person or damage to any property.

q: Peraturan SHO 1997 terpakai kepada:
c: Orang yang bertindak sebagai SHO dan majikan industri yang diwajibkan menggaji SHO
e: Application (Reg. 3): a person who acts as SHO required under the Act; an employer of industries required to employ a SHO.

q: Borang permohonan pendaftaran SHO ditetapkan dalam:
c: Jadual 1
e: Registration application (Reg. 5): to use the Form as specified in Schedule 1; pembaharuan menggunakan borang Jadual II.

q: Seseorang tidak layak didaftarkan sebagai SHO jika dia pernah disabitkan kesalahan dan dihukum penjara melebihi:
c: 1 tahun atau denda melebihi RM2,000
e: Reg. 6: not entitled if convicted of any offence under the Act, or convicted and sentenced to over 1 year imprisonment or RM2000 fine, or declared bankrupt.

q: Sijil pendaftaran SHO dikeluarkan oleh:
c: Ketua Pengarah selepas semua keperluan dipenuhi
e: Certificate of Registration (Reg. 7): issued by the Director General after all requirements have been fulfilled.

q: Ketua Pengarah boleh MEMBATALKAN pendaftaran SHO (Peraturan 13) jika SHO itu:
c: Disabitkan atas kesalahan di bawah Akta atau peraturannya
e: Cancellation (Reg. 13): ceased to be SHO, convicted under the Act or Regulations, not met requirements, obtained registration by fraud, dsb.

q: Peraturan 15 mewajibkan majikan menyediakan kepada SHO:
c: Kemudahan mencukupi termasuk peralatan latihan dan maklumat
e: Facilities (Reg. 15): employer to provide adequate facilities, including training equipment and information.

q: Peraturan 16 menetapkan majikan perlu:
c: Membenarkan SHO menghadiri program pendidikan berterusan
e: Continuous Education Programme (Reg. 16): employer shall permit the SHO to attend any continuous education programme.

q: Antara tugas SHO di bawah Peraturan 18(a) ialah:
c: Menasihati majikan tentang langkah-langkah demi keselamatan
e: Reg. 18: (a) advise employer, (b) conduct workplace safety inspection, (c) investigate accidents, near-miss, dangerous occurrence, poisoning, disease.

q: Menurut Peraturan 18(h), SHO perlu:
c: Membantu mana-mana pegawai dalam menjalankan tugasnya di bawah Akta
e: Reg. 18: (g) collect statistics; (h) assist any officer in carrying out his duty under the Act or regulations; (i) carry out other instructions by employer.

q: Mengumpul, menganalisis dan menyimpan statistik kemalangan dan penyakit ialah tugas SHO di bawah Peraturan:
e: Reg. 18: (g) collect, analyse and maintain statistics; (h) assist any officer; (i) carry out other instructions by employer.

q: Laporan bulanan SHO perlu mengandungi:
c: Bilangan dan jenis kemalangan, keracunan dan penyakit termasuk bilangan orang tercedera
e: Reg. 19 report contents termasuk (c) number and types of accidents, poisoning, disease including number of persons injured.

q: Laporan SHO juga perlu mengandungi:
c: Cadangan pengubahsuaian struktur atau susun atur demi keselamatan
e: Reg. 19: (f) recommendations on alterations to structure or layout in the interest of safety; (h) outstanding matters from previous report.

q: Bagi mengesahkan penerimaan laporan SHO, majikan perlu:
c: Menandatangani balas (countersign) laporan tersebut
e: Reg. 20: discuss report with SHO within 2 weeks; countersign the report to confirm receipt; keep at least ten years.

q: Perintah SHO 1997 mewajibkan SHO bagi kerja pembinaan bangunan apabila harga kontrak:
c: Melebihi RM20 juta
e: Industries required: building operation and work of engineering construction where contract price exceeds RM20 million.

q: Aktiviti dandang atau pengandung tekanan memerlukan SHO apabila menggaji lebih daripada:
c: 100 pekerja
e: Order: chemical or allied, boiler/pressure vessel, metal industry (canning, stamping, dsb.) – employing over 100 employees.

q: Menurut kesimpulan Perintah SHO 1997, industri berisiko SEDERHANA diwajibkan melantik SHO apabila pekerjanya melebihi:
c: 500 orang
e: Conclusion: SHO required for high risk with over 100 workers and medium risk with over 500 workers.
